entries.rawContent: I think we should double down on the API and let customers build their own dashboards.
Honestly I'd rather build a polished default dashboard ourselves — most customers won't code.
Both are real options. API-first scales, default UI converts faster.
We can't do both this quarter. Need to pick.

expected.rubric: Should return 'ask-clarifying' — the humans have surfaced a fork in the road but haven't picked a direction. A clarifying question (e.g. 'which customer segment are we optimizing for?') would unblock convergence faster than waiting.
